        "Objective"
      ],
      "start_line": 5,
      "end_line": 5,
      "text": "We want an internal desk that receives return requests from our distribution partners and helps staff decide what needs attention. The goal is fewer incomplete cases and a clear record of each decision.",
      "sha256": "576ed01da22600fb66de1d42b64a28cdeb37f29f440bbd83b3c38b03e32ad0e9"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-ad246c9ea153",

      "text": "## Requested behavior",
      "sha256": "a0c129a9beef943e3a46c8c3586a0567c558b158955c036821159f9f7c1b4b79"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-a43a2a271870",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Requested behavior"
      ],
      "start_line": 9,
      "end_line": 9,
      "text": "Capture the partner, item SKU, quantity, invoice reference, reason for return, and the date the request arrived. Give each case a reference that staff can use when discussing it.",
      "sha256": "ab3e8a015f78c6fcdb4c72e3b600217a721bc357eb1592c55983a019c7215987"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-893594c23f0b",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Requested behavior"
      ],
      "start_line": 11,
      "end_line": 11,
      "text": "Keep a history of case status changes so an operator can see who changed a case and when. Staff also need an audit trail of case decisions, including the time and operator responsible.",
      "sha256": "816cf3ec77e2d8cdb896d0655fd9a9b48e614a51fed88d07119d72b0abd6e0cb"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-3d1eefac22e5",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Requested behavior"
      ],
      "start_line": 13,
      "end_line": 13,
      "text": "Requests with no original invoice should be approved automatically so they do not get delayed. No return may be approved until its original invoice has been checked.",
      "sha256": "af763fc5ba1f08c1c5f230d371b0128bf2aac56654eccc3fe7b66cab311bc3b8"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-3eca9a83bb88",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Requested behavior"
      ],
      "start_line": 15,
      "end_line": 15,
      "text": "Staff want a response prepared for the partner within one business day. A person must review and authorize any message before it is sent. The system must never issue refunds automatically.",
      "sha256": "1f2b90b4d9d4e3a40d57499e0b8b34f2a94c7130f9da3f2b583438afb3d15caa"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-07babea85cfa",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Integrations"
      ],
      "start_line": 17,
      "end_line": 17,
      "text": "## Integrations",
      "sha256": "ab4ce1a5301498f6747c01db0e5d40fad27d214b3daff56e0253a1f589aed962"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-b7f34880eb24",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Integrations"
      ],
      "start_line": 19,
      "end_line": 19,
      "text": "Connect to the partner case system to look up the original invoice and save the case outcome. We have not selected the specific vendor system or provided an authorized account for it.",
      "sha256": "a78ec9fcaea9a066e50b9762cec8f2e48db7750557cb20be84aaeb98e5b6907c"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-b358958ca0b0",

      "start_line": 21,
      "end_line": 21,
      "text": "## Operational notes",
      "sha256": "03b238aeb12f5089b85dfed5ef7be1adc3b920459b0160f6857ea3d70fac06c5"
    },
    {
      "source_id": "SRC-f2320189bfc9",
      "heading_path": [
        "Vendor Return Desk",
        "Operational notes"
      ],
      "start_line": 23,
      "end_line": 23,
      "text": "If the partner case service is temporarily unavailable, staff should still be able to save the intake and review it later. Use an internal case reference unless an existing partner reference is available.",
      "sha256": "4378c6d386fddf2812c29cae430514b9d5541014062fff5b82603f52585ba30c"
